definitions.seq_ratio: log2((short + 0.5) / (long + 0.5)) per cell, short = cis contacts at 1-Mb map offset 1 (separations 0-2 Mb), long = offsets 19-53 (separations 18-54 Mb), autosomes pooled; cells with >= 500 cis contacts at offsets >= 1
definitions.seq_frac: short / long as fractions of the cis contacts at offsets >= 1 (>= 1 Mb, coarsely)
definitions.imaging_dist_ratio: log2(median d(19-53 Mb pairs) / median d(1-2 Mb pairs)) per cell, copies and autosomes pooled; cells with >= 10 short and >= 30 long pairs
definitions.imaging_prox_ratio: log2((k_s + 0.5) / (n_s + 1)) - log2((k_l + 0.5) / (n_l + 1)), k = pairs closer than r; r = the cell's 1-Mb unit (u1) or the set's median unit (s1)
definitions.contrast: ExN minus Oligo: difference of medians, bootstrap 95% CI over cells (2,000), Cliff's delta, Mann-Whitney P (cells as independent)
definitions.depth_adjusted: OLS value ~ class + log10 depth (cis contacts; imaging: detected locus copies), ExN - Oligo coefficient, bootstrap CI
definitions.thinned: short / long counts thinned binomially to the 20th percentile of contacts at offsets >= 1

set_meta.homologs: authors' DBSCAN labelID: (cell, chromosome) kept when it has exactly two labels, one spot per locus per label

guo.pooled_over: all chromosomes of the histograms (stored pooled)

paired_hic_mouse_cortex.note: per-cell ratios not used (too few contacts per cell): pooled by class only

hicrna_mouse_brain.assay: spatial Hi-C-RNA (Guo 2026), spots by dominant type

hicrna_mouse_brain_domains_r1.assay: spatial Hi-C-RNA (Guo 2026), section r1 by the authors' domains
